mapper.sql: m.id, m.group_id, m.code, m.description, m.created_at, g.id AS g_id, g.code AS g_code, g.name AS g_name, g.description AS g_description, g.created_at AS g_created_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM pjt_i18n_messages m JOIN pjt_i18n_message_groups g ON g.id = m.group_id WHERE m.id = #{id}
SELECT id, group_id, code, description, created_at FROM pjt_i18n_messages WHERE group_id = #{groupId} ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT FROM pjt_i18n_messages m JOIN pjt_i18n_message_groups g ON g.id = m.group_id WHERE g.code = #{groupCode} ORDER BY m.id ASC
SELECT FROM pjt_i18n_messages m JOIN pjt_i18n_message_groups g ON g.id = m.group_id ORDER BY g.id ASC, m.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pjt_i18n_messages (group_id, code, description, created_at) VALUES (#{groupId}, #{code}, #{description}, #{createdAt})
